lede: A pH-balancing mask made in Brazil. It brings hair back to its healthy pH so the cuticle lies flat again — for smoother, shinier hair that holds color — in 5 to 10 minutes.
benefits_intro: Color, bleach, pool water and beach days push hair above its healthy pH. Equalize brings it back down.
benefits: Brings hair back to pH 4.5–5.5, where the cuticle scales lie flat.
With the scales lying flat, hair feels smooth and shines again.
Seals the cuticle back down after color or bleach so color stays in.
Cupuaçu butter holds several times its weight in water.
Patauá oil adds softness, shine and movement.
Smoothing treatments like Select One or Burix One like an acidic environment.

formula.title: Four ingredients, one balancing job
items: Lactic Acid
The ingredient that does the balancing.
Cupuaçu Butter
From the Amazon. Holds several times its weight in water and locks moisture inside.
Patauá Oil
From an Amazon palm, for softness, shine and movement.
18 Amino Acids
The same building blocks hair is made of, to condition weak, porous spots.

steps.title: Your Equalize routine in four steps
steps.intro: A rinse-out mask that does its work in 5 to 10 minutes.
items: Wash & towel dry
Hair should be damp, not dripping.
Apply to lengths & ends
Skip the roots. A walnut-size scoop is enough for shoulder-length hair.
Wait 5–10 minutes
Very dry or bleached hair should take the full 10. Longer doesn't help.
Rinse
Rinse well with cool water, then style as usual.
steps.note: Safety: external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid eye contact; if contact occurs, rinse with plenty of water. If irritation occurs, stop use and seek medical advice. Store in a cool place away from sunlight and heat.

faq: How often should I use it?
1 to 2 times a week, and always after color or bleach.
Will it wash out my keratin treatment?
No. Smoothing treatments like an acidic environment, so Equalize helps the treatment hold.
Sealed hair holds color in; open hair lets it leak out. Equalize seals the cuticle back down.
No, it is a balancing treatment — a different job. Rotate it with your other masks: hydration one wash, protein another, Equalize after any chemical service.
How long does one jar last?
About 2 to 3 months, used 1 to 2 times a week on medium to long hair.
